name: Snapchat public profile page
tier_rationale: Snap Inc., an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P116 FC9 lists Snap as trusted.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

public_profile_page.title: Snapchat public profile page (www.snapchat.com/@{username}, __NEXT_DATA__ props.pageProps)

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

public_profile_page.notes: Research C0272: a scrape of the Next.js data element, terms 'unknown' until legal records them (P116 FC4): disabled in every profile. Schema check: a layout change is ERROR 'layout changed', never empty; bot/challenge pages are BLOCKED (P116 FC6). SnapIntel (AGPL-3.0) was read for ideas only (A6).

notes: Batch p3-G05-2 (P116 snapchat_profile). snapchat.com/add/{u} 308-redirects to www.snapchat.com/@{u}; the module requests www.snapchat.com only.
